name: Charlotte Winter 2025

venue.name: UNC Charlotte Popp Martin Student Union

information:
**All competitors must read the [Competitor Information tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CharlotteWinter2025#50654-competitor-information) prior to registering.**
Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email.

**Minors are required to be accompanied by an adult per University policy.**

Unofficial Event: Face Turning Octahedron (FTO) will be held during lunch.

This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing Inc](https://southeastcubing.org/about)
